experiment: finite-scale settling-time uncertainty on a 2D initial-state slice
epistemic_status: A bounded multiscale numerical diagnostic.  A fitted alpha below one over the sampled scales is not a proof of a fractal set or an asymptotic uncertainty exponent.

field_modification.definition: attention + gamma * (MLP bias + MLP linear term + MLP quadratic-output term); hidden weights and hidden biases are unchanged

slice.base_domain: [-pi, pi) x [-pi, pi), sampled at cell centres
slice.zoom_rule: choose the interior grid cell with the largest four-corner settling-time range, then divide the window width by the fixed zoom factor

settling_definition.settling_time: dt plus the last sampled time at which speed >= tolerance; censored unless the remaining validation tail stays below tolerance

uncertainty_definition.fit: unweighted OLS of log f on log epsilon using only 0 < f < 1
uncertainty_definition.censoring: multiscale uncertainty fractions are conditional on both endpoints being resolved; gamma-trend uncertainty treats an unresolved endpoint as right-censored at the gamma-scan horizon

numerics.integrator: classical explicit RK4; trigonometric periodicity is used within a step and angles are wrapped after the completed step
numerics.execution_note: Persistent job fractal-settling-atlas-260912. Launch 1 was stopped after 142 seconds to make attractor clustering local to each gamma. Launch 2 was stopped after its first 96^2 panel (397 seconds), because 2 of 9216 trajectories were properly right-censored and the then-loaded code would have rejected censoring. Launch 2 subsequently completed all trajectories but stopped before writing when an interpretive terminal-label diagnostic was still fatal. The final run uses 64^2 primary and 32^2 control grids and checkpoints trajectories before analysis; the four zoom levels, time steps, horizons, speed threshold, and deterministic zoom rule are unchanged.

gamma_trend.status: Finite-horizon coarse-grid scan. Unresolved trajectories are right-censored at the gamma-scan horizon.

synchronized_saddle_node.root_solver: sign-change scan followed by Brent's method
synchronized_saddle_node.saddle_node_bracket_method: bisection on the sign of the local synchronized-field maximum; the maximum is computed by bounded scalar minimization
synchronized_saddle_node.bracket_caveat: The bracket is numerical; scalar maximization and floating-point field evaluation are not interval-certified.

saddle_node_scaling_fit.prediction: for a generic saddle-node, root separation and the magnitudes of the common-mode eigenvalues scale as sqrt(gamma-gamma_c)
saddle_node_scaling_fit.caveat: These are four finite-distance points and a numerically estimated critical parameter, not an asymptotic theorem for the full three-angle field.

saddle_node_normal_form.coefficient_source: decimal coefficients stored in the source JSON, evaluated on the exactly synchronized scalar field
saddle_node_normal_form.epistemic_status: numerical high-precision evaluation of stored decimal coefficients; not a symbolic or interval-certified result

jacobian_method.method: central finite differences of the full angular vector field

smooth_saddle_null.model: T(x)=lambda^{-1} log(1/|x|) for a smooth codimension-one saddle
smooth_saddle_null.pairing: nonperiodic horizontal and vertical grid pairs are pooled; the singular line is horizontal, so horizontal pairs contribute zero uncertainty
smooth_saddle_null.comoving_test: the resolution is fixed while the window shrinks; additive shifts in T cancel, so its finite-scale uncertainty fractions need not change under zoom
smooth_saddle_null.interpretation: a low exponent on accessible scales, even when stable under co-moving zoom, is compatible with a smooth saddle. Fixed-region refinement is required to expose the asymptotic codimension-one exponent.

transient_tangent_audit.method: three perturbations evolved with the base trajectory and QR-renormalized every 0.2 normalized time units
transient_tangent_audit.selection_rule: longest resolved point over all primary zooms and the base-grid point nearest the median resolved settling time, both at gamma=1.4348; plus the gamma=1.43475 scan point nearest the source record's terminal state, followed for the full right-censoring horizon
transient_tangent_audit.source_gamma_one_scope: value copied from the source record's finite-horizon continuous ODE audit

rows.scope: Benettin QR estimate along one finite pre-settling trajectory; it is not an asymptotic Lyapunov exponent of an invariant set

finite_horizon_endpoint_clusters.interpretation: Greedy clusters of finite-horizon endpoints. They are not distinct attractors: the weak synchronized direction splits one slow branch.

root_distance_endpoint_audit.status: Post-hoc finite-horizon check. A quiet endpoint closer to the stable synchronized root than to the companion saddle is retained; this is not a proof of its asymptotic destination.

censored_strip_geometry.status: Pixel-scale affine fits to the censor-strip edges and the minimum-time ridge; these are finite-resolution smoothness diagnostics.

fold_normal_form_null.model: du/dt=-a*u^2 at the fold, giving T(u)=1/(a*|u|)
fold_normal_form_null.pairing: nonperiodic horizontal and vertical grid pairs are pooled; the singular line is horizontal, so horizontal pairs contribute zero uncertainty
fold_normal_form_null.asymptotic_prediction: for fixed delta_time and fixed physical region, the uncertain width is proportional to sqrt(epsilon), hence alpha=1/2 although the singular set is a smooth line
fold_normal_form_null.scope: analytic finite-grid null without the atlas censoring and adaptive-zoom rules; it tests whether a low exponent alone identifies fractality

critical_full_jacobian_spectrum.status: central finite differences in the full three-angle field
